description: With the dynamic value as a variadic argument, an error in the result isn't reported
notes: The README and the package documentation don't say whether parameters accept the dynamic value. hashicorp/hcl declares them without AllowDynamicType (decodeUserFunctions in ext/userfunc/decode.go), so go-cty's Function.returnTypeForValues gives the dynamic pseudo-type without calling the function's type callback, and Function.Call then returns the dynamic value without calling the implementation, so the result expression isn't evaluated.
